full_page.content:
The following is a faithful transcription of the carbon copy from the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
1948, February 10
February 104 1948.
V. Sister Sister Agnes Carmel. Sisters of Charity Lansing, Mich.
My Dear Sister Agnes Carmel:
God bless you and yours. I do hope you are well and that this long delayed little message finds you with brighter outlook than seemed to be yours when last I heard from you. Though thank God, it had already brightened.
Now Sister: though my past silence might seem other- wise, I want to assure you that you and especially your poor, dear Parents and folks have been on my mind more than you would think. I surely do sym- pathize with you all. Most especially I may say with your poor, dear Father because, as you seem to think and is quite probable, of the bitter disapoint- ment and scardal he must have met with in some unfortunate judice of a priest. Alas! it seems to be a sad fact, there had to be a Judas among the Twelve Apostles, and ever since there have been those among the priests of holy Mother the Church - sometimes even bishops that have betrayed her. In fact we know that the most terrible scandals have come just thru the falls of priests and bishops. No doubt St. Bernard had this in mind when speaking of scandal he concludes: "Since the scandal of the Crucifiction of Jesus Christ it is never reasonable to take scandal." For that was surely the most terrible scandal of all. And still Almighty God has turned it into the salvation of those who will be saved. O the mysterious ways of the Lord! "How incomprehensible are His Judgement! And how un- seachable His ways!"
